# Where to find all Solomon's Trove items

To start this quest, speak to Leah at the Coe Heritage Museum in Cheyenne System/Akila/Akila City.

Leah will ask you to find and return 6 books to add to the museum.

**Museum location:**

Enter Aila City via the front gate and walk straight towards The Rock.

Stop at the statue of Solomon Coe and turn left so you are facing the Chunk's building.

Walk over to the stairs on the right hand side of the Chunk's building and follow the path

The Museum will be on your left, just before the Sanctum Universum building.

__Book 1__

**Book Name:** Solomon Coe's copy of Don Quixote

**Book Location:**

Cheyenne System/Codos

Fortuna (Marco Graziani's Starship)

You visit this location during the Freestar Collective questline On The Run.

If you forgot to grab the book when you were here for the questline, you can go back and reenter the ship.

Enter the ship and walk straight until you get to the security office. Turn right, open the door, and follow the room around until you get to another circle shaped door. Open the door and turn right. Follow the path around until you get to the end of the ship and can't go any further. There should be a set of stairs on your right. Follow the stairs up and into Marco's office. The book is on the shelf on the right, at the very end of the room, behind Marco's desk.

**Reward:**

150 XP

5000 Credits

__Book 2__

**Book Name:** Solomon's Calculations

**Book Location:**

Volii System/Volii Alpha/Neon

The Emporium/Tevin Anastas

**Reward:**

150 XP

5000 Credits

__Book 3__

**Book Name:** Solomon Coe's Cheyenne Trip Inventory

**Book Location:**

Valo System/Polvo/Hopetown

Ron Hope's Office

You will need to steal this book so try and grab it during The Hammer Falls questline when Ron Hope is not in his office.

**Reward:**

150 XP

5000 Credits

__Book 4__

**Book Name:** List of First Cheyenne Colonists

**Book Location:**

Porrima System/Porrima III/Red Mile

Enter the Red Mile and walk past the Ship Services office. Keep walking forward until you get to the bar. Turn left and walk over to the table on your right. The book is next to Donovan Rhys on the table.

**Reward:**

150 XP

5000 Credits

**Book 5**

**Book Name:** Original Akila City Charter

**Book Location:**

Denebola System/Denebola I-B/Secret Outpost

Lair of the Mantis

You will be sent to this location during the Mantis questline.

Follow the map markers to the end and Claim The Mantis's Spacesuit. There is a room to the right of the Spacesuit. Enter the room and the Book will be in the Science Crate.

**Reward:**

150 XP

5000 Credits

**Book 6**

**Book Name:** Governor's First Meeting Agenda

**Book Location:**

Alpha Centauri System/Jemison/The Lodge

Basement Bedroom

When you enter The Lodge, take the first door on your right. Follow the stairs to the bottom and turn left. Follow the hallway to the end and turn left. The book is on the shelf, next to the desk with all the computers on it.

**Reward:**

150 XP

5000 Credits

The final reward after returning all 6 books

200 XP

6500 Credits

Plus the books are put on display in the Museum
